message_excerpt: Fix two bugs in the reference handling functionality: (#7029)
proposition: GET /ids/globalIds/{globalId}: contract says references=REWRITE rewrites external references to valid registry content references; implementation does rewrite each reference to a version metadata URL without the content suffix, so following it returns metadata instead of the referenced artifact content
inference_notes: ⚠️ Dispatch, validation and serialization inferred statically; no upstream execution.
